summary: A data-driven narrative orchestration Gem for O3DE, designed by Heathen Group. It provides a robust, decoupled framework for managing complex branching dialogue and persistent world state using a unified, hierarchy-aware messaging system. Unlike traditional dialogue tools that couple logic to UI, Ogham operates as a Narrative Event Bus — managing the what and when of your story, while your presentation layer handles the how by responding to standardized EBus events.
